title: Cruise Control and Adaptive Distance Behavior
summary: Feedback on cruise control is split between clear praise for active/adaptive cruise features and many incomplete reports that mention operation, settings, or behavior without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the cruise or adaptive cruise system as enjoyable, effective, and satisfying to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on confusing control placement, difficulty learning how to use cruise control, and dislike of adaptive distance behavior.

mixed.summary: The mixed review describes initial concern about cruise-control operation but then frames it as a change from a prior model rather than a malfunction.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention setting cruise control, inconsistent operation, warnings, or distance adjustment without enough detail to confirm a clear evaluation.

limitations: More than half of the topic reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing overall customer stance.
Several example fragments are truncated or incomplete, so some operational concerns cannot be classified more precisely.
One supplied example assigned as positive contains comparative criticism, which suggests the sample includes borderline or inconsistently labeled feedback.
